riddle_horse.name: Riddle horse
lines: Been here since Friday. You look new. Answer me this.

riddle.question: I have keys but open no doors in here. I wait by the river for you. What am I?
riddle.right: Stairs. Up. Then out the back. Go.
riddle.wrong: Hm. Try the long way. Bring me a Mate if you find one.

riddle_horse.not_yet: You've got nothing that opens anything. Come back with keys.

patrick.name: Patrick
lines: I'm Patrick. From accounting. I'm definitely not a horse.
Exit's that way. Trust me. I do numbers.

herd.name: The herd
lines: *stomps in perfect sync*
herd.warning: We were like you. We stopped looking for the exit.

ice_cream_horse.name: Ice cream horse
lines: Eis?

friday_guy.name: Friday guy
lines: Exit? Left for about 128. Then up.
I came in Friday. What day is it? Don't tell me.

coat_check.name: Coat check
lines: Ticket.

philosopher.name: Philosopher
lines: Who are you, really?

3: Someone with glasses and a jacket.
A horse with a coat check ticket.
5: Someone who lives by the river.

tourists.name: Tourists
lines: Oh my god, the costume! Selfie!
Sorry. We put a sticker on it.

security.name: Security
lines: Hey. Horse. Stop.
Torch says you're a horse.

animal_control.name: Animal control
lines: Come on, buddy. Into the van.
Hey, any chance you could get me in sometime?

bouncer.name: Bouncer
lines: Heute nicht.

leather_choir.name: Leather choir
lines: Mmmm. Mmmm. Mmmm. They're humming the bassline.
Join us. Low notes only.

cleaner.name: Cleaner
lines: Six o'clock. Every Sunday. Mind the floor.
Wet. Floor. Horse.

sink.name: Sink
lines: You wait your turn. Cold water. Clearer.
sink.busy: Someone is washing their whole head in it. Wait a bit.

shoe_collector.name: Shoe collector
lines: Lost a shoe? I've got forty-one left ones.
Not yours. You don't wear shoes. You have hooves.

dj_cousin.name: The DJ's cousin
lines: My cousin's playing. Family only.
Prove it. Stomp on the beat. Eight times.

calm_horse.name: Calm horse
lines: I found out I was a horse years ago. Honestly? Best thing that ever happened.
Don't fight it too hard. But do go home.
